sections.text:
In the depths of the blue ocean, where there was an underwater kingdom made of coral and pearls, lived the King of the Seas with his six mermaid daughters.

The youngest was called Ariel, and she had the most wonderful voice in the whole kingdom, and long red hair that swayed with the waves of the sea.

Unlike her sisters, Ariel was fascinated by the world of humans that lived above the surface of the water.

She spent her time exploring sunken shipwrecks, collecting strange human objects such as forks, mirrors, and artifacts, and hiding them in her secret cave.

Despite her father's constant warnings that humans are dangerous and cruel, Ariel's curiosity and passion for the land has not stopped.

On her fifteenth birthday, Ariel was allowed to rise to the surface of the sea for the first time to see the outside world.

When she stuck her head out of the water, she saw a huge ship holding a loud party, and on board was a handsome human prince named Eric.

Ariel watched the prince with great admiration, but suddenly a violent storm arose, smashing the ship and sinking it into the stormy sea.

Ariel saw Prince Eric drowning, so she quickly dived in and rescued him, pulling him with great effort to the nearby shore.

She sat next to him, singing to him in her sweet voice until he regained consciousness. When he opened his eyes and saw her, Ariel quickly ran away before he could speak to her, but he never forgot her voice.

Ariel returned to the depths of the sea, but she could not stop thinking about the prince, and she became sadder and more isolated.

The evil sea witch Ursula realized how attached Ariel was to the human world, so she used this opportunity to achieve her evil goals of controlling the sea kingdom.

Ursula lured Ariel into her dark lair and offered her a dangerous deal: she would turn her tail into human legs for three days.

During these three days, Ariel must make the prince fall in love with her and kiss her as true love, or else she will return as a nymph and become Ursula's slave forever.

As the price of this deal, the witch demanded Ariel's most valuable possession: her sweet, enchanting voice.

Ariel agreed out of deep love, so she drank a painful magic potion, her tail turned into legs, and she completely lost the ability to speak.

Ariel swam with difficulty to shore, where Prince Eric found her and took her to his palace to take care of her.

Although she could not speak, her kindness and beauty made the prince feel very attracted to her, and they had a wonderful time exploring the kingdom.

The prince almost kissed her on the second day during a boat ride, but the witch Ursula's snakes intervened and capsized the boat to prevent this.

To ensure Ariel's failure, Ursula disguised herself as a beautiful human girl named Vanessa, and used Ariel's voice trapped in her shell to sing to the prince.

As soon as the prince heard the voice, he thought that Vanessa was the girl who saved him, and decided to marry her immediately thanks to a magic spell.

Ariel felt her heart break as she saw her prince preparing to marry the disguised witch on the third and last day.

But Ariel's friends, the seabirds and fish, discovered the truth about Vanessa, and launched a surprise attack on the wedding to disrupt it.

During the chaos, the shell around Vanessa's neck shattered, the voice returned to Ariel, and the spell on the prince was broken.

Prince Eric realized that Ariel was his true savior and true love, but the sun had set and the three days were over!
Ariel reverts to her mermaid form, and Ursula, revealing her terrifying form, drags her into the depths of the ocean to begin her enslavement.

The King of the Seas tried to save his daughter, but Ursula forced him to give up his throne and crown in exchange for Ariel's freedom, so the devoted father agreed.

Ursula became very large and terrifying and began creating a destructive vortex storm to kill everyone.

But Prince Eric did not abandon Ariel, so he led a wrecked ship with extreme courage, and directed its sharp prow directly into the heart of the giant witch!
Ursula died, her dark magic ended, the Sea King regained his power, and all the trapped souls returned to normal.

When the king saw the true love exchanged between his daughter and the human prince, he realized that her happiness lay on land.

The king used his great magic to permanently transform Ariel into a human.
Ariel returned to Eric, and a huge wedding was held attended by humans and mermaids, so that peace and love would reign between the two worlds forever.
